item.title: [ABC Action News / Tampa Bay 28] One Tampa homeowner's backyard project is exactly what city leaders say affordable housing needs
item.description: Since rule changes took effect in 2024, 28 Tampa homeowners have started the ADU process and 7 have completed construction, including one Sulphur Springs homeowner nearing the finish line.

item.title: [ABC Action News / Tampa Bay 28] Regulators warn retailers that personalized pricing could be illegal
item.description: Federal regulators are proposing new standards to keep retailers from changing their prices based on individual buyers' data.

item.title: [FOX 13 Tampa Bay] Howard Frankland Bridge Express Lanes: Electronic tolling begins Saturday
item.description: Drivers crossing Old Tampa Bay on Interstate 275 will soon pay electronic tolls as new Express Lanes open on the Howard Frankland Bridge on Saturday, according to the Florida Department of Transportation.

item.title: [FOX 13 Tampa Bay] Manatee County Habitat for Humanity gets $750K in state funds for Palmetto townhomes infrastructure
